title: Essential: E0 expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for part (1) must be E0 = mgd(R1+R2)/(qR2).

title: Essential: B expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for part (2) must be B = mv/(2dq).

title: Essential: E' expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for part (3) must be E' = mg/(2q).

title: Important: Force balance in capacitor
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply vertical force balance (qE = mg) to relate the capacitor's electric field to the ball's weight.

title: Important: Circuit analysis
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly use Ohm's Law and voltage division to find the potential difference across R2 and relate it to the capacitor's electric field (Ed).

title: Important: Circular motion geometry
description: Important Criteria: The solution must use the geometry of the circular trajectory (Pythagorean theorem with radius r, plate length √3d, and plate separation d) to find the radius r = 2d.

title: Important: Magnetic centripetal force
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply the Lorentz force as the centripetal force (qvB = mv²/r) to relate B to m, v, q, and the radius r.

title: Important: Post-exit force balance
description: Important Criteria: For part (3), the solution must set up a force balance where the new electric force qE' balances the component of gravity along the ball's velocity direction after exit.

title: Pitfall: Incorrect radius
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly determines the radius of the circular motion (e.g., using r = d or ignoring the geometry).

title: Pitfall: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student makes a sign or vector direction error in force balances, especially for the electric field in part (3).
